## User need

What are you trying to build, and what is difficult today?

## Existing alternatives

Which native HTML, Syntyr classes, tokens, recipes, or application-local CSS have you tried? Why are they insufficient?

## Proposed improvement

Describe the desired outcome, relevant examples, browser/accessibility needs, and any API or maintenance tradeoffs.

## Additional context

Link related issues or pull requests. Avoid confidential or personal data.
